missions: Every packet carries its minted mission id (see each packet's `mission`); docs/new-plan/ owns status from here, and is dispositioned in docs/new-plan/coverage.md.

protocol.reVerifyFirst: Every packet re-checks its findings on fresh main before writing code; a finding already fixed closes the row with a note and no PR.
protocol.claim: Draft PR naming the packet id before implementing, listing the findings claimed and the file trees touched.
protocol.disjointTrees: Two packets in the same wave never name the same file. fileTrees is the contract.
protocol.hotFile: src/diagnostics/messages.ts — only one packet per wave may mint a loom.* code there.
protocol.proof: Any packet adding a validator or test must show it FAILS when the fix is reverted, and say so in the PR body. Revert the mutation with a file copy, never `git checkout -- <path>`.
protocol.emitterPackets: A packet changing an emitter must compile the generated project for that backend locally. See the loom-test-suites skill for Docker recipes and loom-ci-gates for the workflow/label mapping.
